model_revision: <40-hex commit SHA; self-hosted (OCR_UPSTREAM=openai-vision) deployments only — the Datalab-hosted default (OCR_UPSTREAM=datalab) is a third-party API with no pinnable checkpoint, so this is unset there>

receipt.verify: GET /capability → pub_key_hex; verify signature over canonical(receipt)

revision_probe.route: <runtime info route reporting the loaded checkpoint; self-hosted (openai-vision) upstream only>
revision_probe.policy: self-hosted (OCR_UPSTREAM=openai-vision) upstream: probe before every Claim, mismatch refuses the job. Datalab-hosted default (OCR_UPSTREAM=datalab): per-job liveness probe only, no checkpoint pin.
